confirmed_behavior.name: Structural transaction states
confirmed_behavior.statement: Draft to submitted to cancelled; restricted updates after submission; separate discard operation for drafts.

confirmed_behavior.name: Optimistic concurrency and locking
confirmed_behavior.statement: Ordinary save compares original modification timestamp to locked stored state; generic update can load current state before applying values.

confirmed_behavior.name: Effective metadata
confirmed_behavior.statement: Custom fields and property overrides precede effective columns, permissions, and actions.

confirmed_behavior.name: Numeric policy variants
confirmed_behavior.statement: Nearest even, away-from-zero half, and scale-sensitive half policies remain selectable; metadata fallback differs from configured test-fixture expectation.

confirmed_behavior.name: Permission composition
confirmed_behavior.statement: Role, ownership, linked-record restrictions, controller denials, explicit sharing, and field masking have distinct ordered behavior.

confirmed_behavior.name: Bulk partial success
confirmed_behavior.statement: Transport uses per-item savepoints; import and bulk workflow commit successful documents individually.

confirmed_behavior.name: Event and job consistency
confirmed_behavior.statement: After-commit eligibility, active-job deduplication, immediate progress, and outgoing-delivery retry are distinct guarantees.

open_validation_cases.name: Background retry identity
open_validation_cases.classification: Observed static source discrepancy; no live reproduction
open_validation_cases.statement: Internal retry releases context and omits initiating user when recursively executing. Connection defaults to administrative user. Measure identity across attempts and explicitly choose any corrective replacement behavior.

open_validation_cases.name: Task progress visibility
open_validation_cases.statement: Task subscription handlers accept a task identifier without document-style permission checks. Do not infer ownership authorization.

open_validation_cases.name: Savepoint external effects
open_validation_cases.statement: Savepoint rollback does not reset full-transaction callbacks or undo external files. Verify callbacks and attachments from failed batch items.

open_validation_cases.name: Workflow path consistency
open_validation_cases.statement: Dedicated workflow action checks self-approval; generic workflow state validation checks transition availability. Verify direct state-field mutation behavior.

open_validation_cases.name: Creation response filtering
open_validation_cases.classification: Observed path difference requiring field-level acceptance
open_validation_cases.statement: Generic creation returns inserted representation directly; read and update explicitly filter fields. Verify exposure of restricted creation values.

open_validation_cases.name: Chunked upload concurrency
open_validation_cases.statement: Temporary assembly is filename-based. Verify same-name parallel upload, duplicate chunks, and interrupted finalization before claiming resumability.

open_validation_cases.name: Combined-system execution
open_validation_cases.statement: Selected source tests were inspected but not executed; application composition and domain-specific invariants require combined acceptance execution.

coverage_exclusions: Deployment topology and server product prescriptions
Automatic identification of every domain controller invariant from metadata alone
